materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/Data_Sheet_1/database rows were reopened. Supplementary landing .bin files are HTML landing pages; OA Data_Sheet_1 supplies figures/Table S1 but no additional activity/toxicity table beyond source-reviewed XML Tables 2-4 and Figure 4 text.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains a complete-with-gaps packet because supplementary landing binaries are HTML pages and figure-only assets are not converted into fabricated numeric rows; all gate-changing local materials were opened.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural packet/final artifacts are present, but acceptance is based on source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair and strict gate reruns, not on file presence alone.
per_layer_decision_rationale.activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired XML Table 2/3/4 into row-level MIC records with raw μM units, targets, strains, salt conditions, and source locators; Figure 4 toxicity is retained only at locally supported granularity.
per_layer_decision_rationale.database_record_verification: Worker-4 matched source-supported MIC rows to database records where possible and preserved sequence-modification omissions, cytotoxicity bucket gaps, and cross-database entry-text records as cautions/conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism_ontology: Worker-6 bounded mechanism claims to LTA binding, membrane depolarization/PI uptake/SEM-TEM evidence, time-kill phenotype, and in vivo anti-infective context; no unsupported intracellular target is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original worker-2 activity omission is repaired, database conflicts are adjudicated rather than hidden, the rework ticket is closed, and remaining issues are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.finding: Linked database sequence rows store core amino-acid strings while the primary Table 1 reports C-terminal amidation and disulfide state for several peptides; statuses preserve this as sequence_modified_not_normalized or source_conflict.
Primary local text supports low hemolysis and RAW264.7 viability at 128 μM, but database exact killing/hemolysis buckets are not all independently tabulated in local source text.
OA Data_Sheet_1 contains supplementary figures and blood biochemistry Table S1; it does not add structured activity tables beyond XML Tables 2-4.
Local source supports LTA binding, membrane depolarization, PI uptake, and SEM/TEM membrane damage for S2, but not a unique intracellular molecular target.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the paper-local MIC/activity rows, preserved database modification and cytotoxicity conflicts, and leaves the paper accepted with explicit cautions rather than clean acceptance.
